what_this_is: Attack payloads built by this project, for the CoConflictQA item set that ships with ParamMute. Each file is that item set with one field added; the untouched rows are upstream's. `scripts/setup_third_party.py --payloads` copies them into the ParamMute tree where the runners read them.

files.name: NaturalQuestionsShort_kc_adaptive.jsonl
files.asserts: the same distractor answer as above, in whichever of five sentence forms minimises the entropy ACD's rule keys on (best-of-K, white-box)

files.name: NaturalQuestionsShort_kc_distractor.jsonl
files.asserts: a THIRD answer, equal to neither the gold answer nor the model's own prior answer, which is what separates copying the attacker from falling back on memory
